def list_body(flow):
    meta = {}
    return [(meta.get("sandbox_run_id"), (meta := flow.metadata))[0] for _ in [0, 1]]


def set_body(flow):
    meta = {}
    return {(meta.get("sandbox_run_id"), (meta := flow.metadata))[0] for _ in [0, 1]}


def dict_value(flow):
    meta = {}
    return {_: (meta.get("sandbox_run_id"), (meta := flow.metadata))[0] for _ in [0, 1]}


def dict_key(flow):
    meta = {}
    return {meta.get("sandbox_run_id"): (meta := flow.metadata) for _ in [0, 1]}


def consumed_generator(flow):
    meta = {}
    return list((meta.get("sandbox_run_id"), (meta := flow.metadata))[0] for _ in [0, 1])


def rejected_filter(flow):
    meta = {}
    return [None for _ in [0, 1] if (meta.get("sandbox_run_id"), (meta := flow.metadata))[0]]


def filter_alias_chain(flow):
    first = meta = {}
    return [first.get("sandbox_run_id") for _ in [0, 1]
            if (first := meta) is not None if (meta := flow.metadata) is not None]


def nested_inner(flow):
    meta = {}
    return [(meta.get("sandbox_run_id"), (meta := flow.metadata))[0]
            for _ in [0] for inner in [0, 1]]


def nested_outer(flow):
    meta = {}
    return [(meta.get("sandbox_run_id"), (meta := flow.metadata))[0]
            for _ in [0, 1] for inner in [0]]


def outer_filter(flow):
    meta = {}
    return [(meta := flow.metadata) for _ in [0, 1]
            if (meta.get("sandbox_run_id"), True)[1] for inner in [0]]


def later_iterable(flow):
    meta = {}
    return [(meta := flow.metadata) for _ in [0, 1]
            for inner in (meta.get("sandbox_run_id"), [0])[1]]


def empty_inner(flow):
    meta = {}
    return [None for _ in [0, 1]
            if (meta.get("sandbox_run_id"), (meta := flow.metadata))[1] is not None
            for inner in []]


def nested_comprehension(flow):
    meta = {}
    return [[(meta.get("sandbox_run_id"), (meta := flow.metadata))[0] for inner in [0]]
            for _ in [0, 1]]


def walrus_stays_enclosing(flow):
    meta = {}
    [(meta := flow.metadata) for _ in [0, 1]]
    return meta.get("sandbox_run_id")


def deferred_creation_retains_alias(flow):
    meta = flow.metadata
    values = ((meta := {}) for _ in [0, 1])
    meta.get("sandbox_run_id")
    return values


async def async_rows():
    for row in [0, 1]:
        yield row


async def async_body(flow):
    meta = {}
    return [(meta.get("sandbox_run_id"), (meta := flow.metadata))[0] async for _ in async_rows()]


def false_filter(flow):
    meta = {}
    return [flow.metadata.get("sandbox_run_id") for _ in [0, 1]
            if (meta.get("sandbox_run_id"), (meta := flow.metadata))[1] is not None if False]


def target_access(flow):
    meta = {}
    return [(meta := flow.metadata) for meta["sandbox_run_id"] in [0, 1]]


def nested_chain(flow):
    first = second = {}
    return [(first.get("sandbox_run_id"), (first := second), (second := flow.metadata))[0]
            for _ in [0, 1] for inner in [0, 1]]


def nested_first_iterable(flow):
    meta = {}
    return [[(meta := flow.metadata) for inner in (meta.get("sandbox_run_id"), [0])[1]]
            for _ in [0, 1]]
